_comment: Known precursor patterns per hazard type. known_precursors in the risk formula is the length of the matching list; keywords drive detection against the current report and its retrieved historical matches.

lockout_tagout.description: Maintenance performed without isolating the energy source.
Multiple crews on one machine with no group lock box.
Residual pressure, spring or gravity energy left in the system.
Zero-energy state never tested before work began.

confined_space.description: Entry made without testing oxygen or toxic gas levels.
A would-be rescuer entered and became a second casualty.
Permit-required space entered with no permit issued.
No one stationed outside to monitor the entrant.
Space not purged or continuously ventilated.

machine_guarding.description: A fixed or interlocked guard was removed to speed up the task.
Operator reached into the point of operation to clear a jam.
Rotating parts, belts or rollers left exposed.
The same machine produced earlier close calls with no action.

fall_protection.description: Harness worn but never tied off to an anchor point.
Open edge, hole or skylight without a guardrail or cover.
Ladder unsecured, over-reached, or wrong type for the task.
Scaffold erected or modified without a competent-person check.
Worker walked a roof or panel not rated for the load.

chemical_release.description: Known degradation of piping or vessel walls before failure.
Relief valve isolated, plugged or undersized.
Equipment or process altered without a formal MOC review.
Reactive chemicals combined outside design conditions.
Operators had normalised repeated nuisance alarms.

fire_explosion.description: Dust layers on surfaces provided the secondary explosion fuel.
Hot work, static or non-rated equipment near flammables.
Flammable liquids stored outside approved cabinets or areas.
Sprinklers or deluge out of service at the time.

electrical.description: Work on live parts with no energized-work permit or justification.
Incorrect or absent arc-rated clothing for the incident energy.
Known damaged cords, tools or panels left in service.
Portable tools used in wet locations without GFCI.

struck_by.description: Pedestrians and mobile equipment sharing an undivided route.
Material shifted or fell because it was not restrained.
Personnel positioned beneath a crane or hoist load.
Reversing or blind-lift operation run with no spotter.

hot_work.description: Cutting or welding started without a permit or hazard review.
No fire watch during the work or through the post-work period.
Combustibles within the required radius were not removed or covered.
Work on a tank or line still holding flammable residue.

material_handling.description: Lift or rack loaded beyond its rated capacity.
Material stacked too high or on uneven footing.
Slings, chains or hooks with known defects kept in service.
Repeated heavy lifts with no mechanical aid.

general.description: The worker had not been trained on the task or hazard.
A written procedure existed but was bypassed under time pressure.
The same hazard had been reported or cited before.
No competent person oversaw a high-risk task.
Obstructed walkways, spills or clutter in the work area.
